$meta.name: RITC Resolve config
consumers: the Resolve MCP session, which reads this file and applies it through set_project_setting, create_bin, and set_render_settings
$meta.source: Canvas sizes and safe zones from brand/tokens.json. Camera list from the toolkit template; which bodies actually cover RITC is unconfirmed, see video/README.md named gaps.

framerate_note: Instagram serves 30fps; 29.97 or 30 avoids a pulldown. Set 23.976 only when every source is 23.976 and the post is a film-style piece, not a workout clip.

graphics.title_card: templates/story.html exported at 2x, 2160x3840, imported to Graphics/Cards
graphics.end_card: templates/story.html with cta set and photo empty, exported at 2x, imported to Graphics/Cards
graphics.badge: assets/logo/ritc-badge-512.png, imported to Graphics/Logo, placed bottom-left or bottom-right at 96px minimum on the 1080 canvas, 25 percent clear space

reel.name: RITC Reel 9x16
reel.note: Canvas only. Reframe per clip before rendering vertical; the preset does not follow subjects.

master.name: RITC Master ProRes
master.note: Archive copy of the vertical cut. Goes to the video archive, not to Instagram and not to the repo.
